decision_question: Can the retained R3 five-family Automotive Surface Source architecture clear Machine QA after correcting termination continuation geometry and evidence zoning without relaxing any existing quality threshold?

evidence_zoning.rule: Termination continuation uses the existing broad-interior radius threshold outside inherited shoulder/rocker character bands while whole-zone cell-area/non-degeneracy remains checked. boundary: R3.2 is a Working Source correction inside the existing R3 architecture and R3.1 evidence semantics. It does not add a system Gate, does not relax thresholds, and cannot open PAP or Promotion without Machine plus Human Project/Visual PASS.
